_notes.08d: beh 0x3F jump south-west: corner joining a W-facing ledge above (085) and an S-facing ledge to the east (087) at Lilycove (49,17); main direction picked as S, W is equally defensible | verify: ledge_s -> ledge_cap: Ledge corner (W-facing ledge 085 above turning into S-facing ledge 087 to the east). Behaviour 0x3F (MB_JUMP_SOUTHWEST) is never jumpable in pokeruby: GetLedgeJumpDirection (src/event_object_movement.c) only tests MetatileBehavior_IsJumpSouth/North/West/East, which match 0x3B/0x3A/0x39/0x38 only, and the tile has collision 1 in all 7 uses. In Sapphire it is a solid ledge corner; labelled ledge_s the builder would add a jump that does not exist. Same as Mauville 201/2bb, which are already ledge_cap. Other uses: Route115 (15,71), (29,67); Route123 (29,11).
